items.reason: The Scratch Patch and Topstones pages describe the online shop (categories, shipping in two working days, requests by email) and the chain's shops in general. The Glencairn shop itself was not described, and chain-wide facts alone are not allowed.
The Mr D Food page is for Shin Thai Asian Kitchen Sushi in Muizenberg, not the Marina da Gama branch. TripAdvisor and Dining Out were blocked. No Marina da Gama facts were found.
Chain supermarket. Only the mydorpie contact entry for the Nyanga Junction Centre (address and phone) and generic Shoprite pages were found. Chain-wide facts alone are not allowed.
The Cape Quarter store directory does not list Skin Renewal, and no other source about the business was found.

Only the Cylex directory profile was found (timber merchant and building materials at 137 Wetton Road, hours, categories). The southernboards.co.za site was not fetched, and that is not enough for 100 real words.

Hotfrog and iGlobal directory pages describe a SPAR Express in partnership with Shell (forecourt shopping, Bean Tree coffee, snacks, fuel). That is too thin for a branch description, and the SPAR store-view page was only a link.
Chain sports retailer. Only the company homepage and About page (since 1986, cookie banner, newsletter text) were found. No Sea Point branch facts were sourced.
Chain clothing store. The Tiendeo store page gives only the Golden Acre address, phone and marketing text. Chain-wide facts alone are not allowed.

Only the africabz directory entry (address, hours, phone) and user reviews were found. The pharmacy belongs to a chain (Alpha Pharmacies) and the chain site was not fetched. Review quotes are not enough for 100 real words.

Only the africabz directory entry (Arts Village address, hours, phone) and about 28 user reviews, which mention the selection, special orders and setting. The Facebook page was not fetched, so the review quotes alone are not enough for an honest description.

Directory pages only: a family-run factory outlet and wholesaler for candles and accessories, with three Cape Town stores serving the public and event, catering, hospitality, spa and florist trades. The directories give other addresses (Maitland, Retreat-Tokai, Brackenfell) and the Kensington branch was not confirmed. About 75 words of real content.

The Village Hub page gives only the Coffee Station's opening times (7:30 in summer, 8:00 in winter), freshly baked croissants and muffins, and cycling pit-stop use. That is not enough for 100 real words.
Franchise chain contact page only (franchise enquiries, head office, bold South African flavour). No Melkbosstrand branch facts were found, and chain-wide facts alone are not allowed.

Only the business's Facebook page was usable: the tagline 'Your neighbourhood cafe', the Montrose and Upper Orange Street address, and opening hours. No menu, services or history were found, and the own site and southafricafirm listing timed out.

Only an africabz directory entry and user reviews (mixed comments about stock and service). Chain-wide Pick n Pay facts alone are not allowed, and no 3Arts Village branch-specific services were found.

Only an africabz directory entry (address, hours, lingerie store) and user reviews, which are mixed about fitting rooms and returns. The factoryshops.co.za page was not fetched. Not enough for 100 real words without padding.

The own contact page gives the Mowbray branch address (47 Durban Road), phone and daily hours only. The menu and branch pages on fatcactus.co.za returned 404 or were blocked, and the directory entries had no descriptive content. Chain-wide facts alone are not allowed.
The tigersmilk.co.za site timed out. The only results were unrelated pages about tigers, so nothing about this Cape Town CBD restaurant was found.

Only one Cape Town ETC interview was found, and it covers the bar together with its sister store Just Like Papa. No bar-only facts from the business itself were found, so a description would rely on the owner's story about another business.
Chain liquor store. Only the my-catalogue listing (R102 Main Road address, trading hours and phone) and catalogue pages were found. No branch-specific services or products were sourced.
Only the africabz directory entry (hair salon and barber, hours, phone) and about 49 user reviews. The urban-men.com site did not resolve. Review quotes alone are not enough for 100 real words.

Only the africabz directory entry (recruiter and employment consultant, hours, phone) and user reviews. The company site westcoastpersonnel.co.za was not fetched, so no firm-specific services were found.

Only the sayellow directory entry (independent bookshop franchise established 1993, hours, Dean Street Arcade address). The shop's own site was not found, and the directory copy alone is about 70 words.

Factory Shops SA and Yep directory entries give conflicting trading hours (Mon-Thu 08:00-16:00 and Fri 08:00-13:00 versus Mon-Fri 08:00-17:00), and the akknit.co.za site is blocked. The only product facts are a short list of fabrics (babywear, cotton, fleece, jersey, towelling). That is not enough for 100 real words.
Only a Yellosa directory line (expert civil, family and criminal law services, established 2013) was found. No firm website or further detail was in the research.
Chain retailer. Only the my-catalogue store listing for the Kismet Building (address, hours, phone) was found, with no branch-specific products or services. Chain-wide facts alone are not allowed.
Chain builders' merchant. Only the Cashbuild store locator, catalogue and chain-level pages were found, none about the Makhaza branch. Chain-wide facts alone are not allowed.
Only the Apple Maps listing (used bookstore at 199 Long Street, phone and hours) was found. The shop website clarkesbooks.co.za was not in the research, so no description content could be sourced.
Chain financial services store. Only the africabz directory entry (address, hours, insurance agency category) and user reviews were found. Chain-wide facts alone are not allowed.

Only the sa-venues directory page: an institution for locals and visitors on the False Bay coast with ocean views and a pub. About 70 words of real content, and the business's own site was not fetched.

Only the sa-venues directory page for Imhoff's Free Range Farm Shop (free range foods, lamb and cranberry pies, honey, cheeses, old-fashioned drinks). About 80 words of real content, and the farm's own site was not in the research.

Only the africabz directory entry and user reviews (takeaway, biryani and tikka comments, some negative). The ghazalas.co.za site was not in the research. Review quotes alone are not enough for 100 real words.
